{{Quote|Battling with Warlord Teradoc and your Admiral Ackbar for Zsinj's leavings, I fared rather poorly.|Teren Rogriss, to [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>}}
After the death of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], a '''three-way campaign''' broke out between [[Admiral/Legends|Admirals]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]], [[Teren Rogriss]], and [[Treuten Teradoc]] over the remains of [[Zsinj's Empire|his empire]].

==History==
{{Quote|I cost your New Republic a lot in that struggle. I've nothing to be ashamed of.|Teren Rogriss, to Wedge Antilles|<ref name="X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar" />}}
When [[Zsinj]] died at the [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|Battle of Dathomir]], Admiral Teren Rogriss of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&mdash;formerly in a loose partnership with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in the [[Hunt for Zsinj|campaign to take down Zsinj]]&mdash;abandoned any pretense of an alliance and moved into Zsinj's former territory to grab what he could. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] of the New Republic, meanwhile, lead the New Republic fleet into Zsinj's territory to secure worlds for his own government. Thanks to a recent alliance with the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]], Ackbar was able to use a number of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] gifted to the New Republic in his campaign.<ref name="NEC" />

Meanwhile in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] and self-styled [[High Admiral]] [[Treuten Teradoc]] of the [[Greater Maldrood]], who had long skirmished with Zsinj before the latter's death, saw his own chance and moved across the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] to seize the worlds of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]]. He ran directly into the middle of Rogriss and Ackbar's war, and the two-way conflict became a three-way fight.<ref name="TEA" />

The New Republic was involved in some of the worst of the fighting, with its Star Destroyers getting the brunt of the conflict. The Star Destroyer ''[[Crynyd]]'' and most of the [[Hapan]] ships were lost, ''[[Emancipator]]'' and [[Liberator (Imperial I-class)|''Liberator'']] were severely damaged and had to be pulled back for repairs, and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Rebel Dream]]'' was attacked and captured by the Empire's ''[[Peremptory]]'' at the [[Battle of Storinal]], though Organa was not aboard at the time. But Rogriss suffered more, losing the majority of his battles.<ref name="NEC" /> Teradoc [[Battle of Junction|beat]] the Imperial admiral at [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Feriae Junction]], winning the loyalty of many of Zsinj's ships, but it was not enough to save him. He lost heavily to Ackbar at [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] and [[Thanos]], the latter in his own territory; the New Republic moved in to take [[Gala]] and ultimately Teradoc's capital of [[Centares/Legends|Centares]], and the warlord's kingdom collapsed. Teradoc fled the battle and his territory for the security of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], where he established himself anew.<ref name="TEA" />

Meanwhile, the New Republic was doing more damage to the Empire than vice versa. When at last they [[Taking of Kuat|captured]] the major shipyard world of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], Rogriss was forced to retreat. The New Republic emerged from the conflict victorious, holding three-quarters of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="NEC" />
